story.body: You ate at Mistress Ansell's table and told her not to lay a place at noon. The loaf was shrunk on the pan. You did not measure it. You said you would be back before dark.

story.body: You stood the service at St Helen's. Master Thwaite stopped at one glass and then read the portion he had been ordered to read. You lost the psalm when she turned, and you said nothing. At the end the north porch was empty.
